Game Overview

In Xmas Balls, the core idea is straightforward: join a festive adventure in Xmas Balls, where quick reflexes and strategic shots are your tools to protect holiday gifts. Blast through falling blocks, unlock joyful power-ups, and conquer escalating speeds in this cheerful, addictive holiday challenge. Can you keep up and save Christmas?
